definitions.LOFBI: damaging dosage 2 OR (dosage >= 1 AND (own CN < cn_loss OR SIL OR LikelyLoF call with AF >= lof_bi_af_min)) OR (X-linked AND male AND dosage >= 1)
definitions.FUS: filtered fusion, FFPM >= ffpm_min, driver (configs/fusion_drivers.csv) in its required orientation
definitions.SIL-METH: SIL with promoter methylation >= meth_high (not SIL-DEL/MUT)
definitions.METH: gene_value >= meth_high AND gene_value - D lineage median >= 0.3; restricted_gene_set genes only; >= min_carriers among RRBS-profiled D lines; NA for lines without RRBS
definitions.YABS: Y paralog absent: female, or male with SIL of the Y gene
definitions.EXPDOSE: own log2(TPM+1) - D mean among expressed lines (>= expressed_log2tpm), 0 elsewhere
definitions.PSCORE: mean D-fitted z of member genes

feature_record_note: keys with null/false/empty values are omitted; source is per family (sources_by_family)

SIL-DEL: expression (P1 cache expression.parquet) + CN/damaging for mechanism
SIL-METH: expression (P1 cache expression.parquet) + CN/damaging for mechanism
SIL-other: expression (P1 cache expression.parquet) + CN/damaging for mechanism
LOFBI: damaging dosage + CN + SIL (P1 caches) + OmicsSomaticMutations LikelyLoF/AF
YABS: Model.csv Sex + SIL of the Y paralog within males
PSCORE: expression; members from design_params / P1 Hallmark GMT
SIG: OmicsSomaticMutations: log1p(number of default-entry protein-altering calls in OmicsSomaticMutations)
